item.title: elizaOS Intelligence: 2026-08-01
item.description:
Summary: Development activity remains high with the release of ElizaOS v3 and new Solana trading plugins, though community communication gaps and recruitment spam have been noted. The project is focused on infrastructure hardening and expanding agent capabilities for household coordination.

GitHub Activity:

  • Resolve agent management failures (merged)
  • Agentic Parent Suite requirements (open)

Community Highlights:

  • #coders: Release of the pnllabs Solana trading plugin and associated smart money wallet audit results....
  • #discussion: Community frustration regarding the inactivity of official communication channels since May 2026, contrasted with active GitHub development....
